faq.title: All your questions answered with clarity
faq.subtitle: Whether you are a student or a future instructor, find answers to key questions about how our platform works.
faq.q1: How do I access courses on FormationSession?
faq.a1: Create your free account, browse our catalog, and enroll in your chosen course. Access to HD videos and PDF booklets is instant and unlimited for life.
faq.q2: Are courses accessible on smartphone and tablet?
faq.a2: Yes, our high-definition video player and platform are 100% responsive so you can learn at home or directly in your workshop.
faq.q3: How can I become an instructor and share my craft?
faq.a3: Click on 'Become an Instructor' and submit your curriculum. Our team will review your application, validate your project, and support you through launch.
faq.q4: What are the fees for instructors?
faq.a4: We offer a transparent subscription model with 0% sales commission: you keep 100% of your course earnings, with hosting and billing fully automated.
faq.a5: You have 14 full days after enrollment to test the course. If the content does not meet your expectations, we will issue a full refund upon simple request.
faq.q6: Do courses provide certificates of completion?
faq.a6: Yes, completing a course awards an official personal certificate of achievement validating the skills and techniques taught.
faq.q7: Can I ask questions to my instructor if I need guidance?
faq.a7: Absolutely. A dedicated discussion space is open beneath each lesson to ask questions and receive personalized advice.
faq.q8: Are all practical crafts and skills welcome?
faq.a8: Yes! Our catalog is constantly growing: fine crafts, gastronomy, wellness, digital tools, and creative disciplines. We welcome all authentic expertise.

about_page.title: Transmitting, elevating and revealing craftsmanship
about_page.subtitle: The independent academy dedicated to authentic crafts, wellness disciplines, and tomorrow's essential skills.
about_page.main_heading: Where mastery of craft meets modern digital engineering.
about_page.intro_p1: FormationSession was born from the harmony between hands-on trade expertise and modern web technology. We firmly believe that every artisan, practitioner, baker, or creator possesses valuable know-how that deserves to be shared with dedication and care.
about_page.intro_p2: Our role is to remove technical barriers: we provide an intuitive platform, high-definition video streaming, and secure automated payouts with zero commission on sales. Instructors retain 100% of their intellectual property and earnings, while students enjoy practical, engaging, and directly applicable workshops.
about_page.step1_desc: No abstract theory disconnected from reality: each course is taught by an active professional who practices their trade daily.
about_page.step2_desc: 0% commission on sales. Instructors set their own pricing, keep 100% of their profits, and retain complete ownership of their content.
about_page.step3_desc: From ceramic wheel throwing to sourdough baking, energetic wellness to AI workflows, we bridge creative fields without artificial boundaries.
about_page.step4_desc: Lifetime access, HD video streaming, downloadable guides, and direct discussion between instructors and students under every lesson.
about_page.step5_title: The bridge between digital and workshop
about_page.step5_desc: Fostering an engaged community where online learning seamlessly prepares and extends physical practice in studios and regions.
about_page.team1_bio: Certified practitioner and therapist with extensive experience in Normandy (energy healing, LaHoChi, dowsing). Fabienne instills genuine care, ethical guidance, and respect for each student's personal learning journey.
about_page.team2_bio: Founder of Nümtema Agency, experience designer, and specialist in AI and automation. Lionel architects FormationSession with one mission: empowering creators with top-tier technology without technical overhead.
about_page.val1_desc: Every instructor remains fully in control of their pedagogy and receives earnings directly without hidden middleman fees.
about_page.val2_desc: A distraction-free, lightning-fast interface ensuring technology steps aside for the pure joy of learning.
about_page.val3_desc: A safe, respectful, and constructive environment encouraging meaningful dialogue between masters and learners.
about_page.val4_desc: Battle-tested techniques, step-by-step equipment guides, and precise demonstrations filmed clearly.

become_trainer_page.faq4_a: Yes, all plans are 100% contract-free. You can pause or cancel your subscription at any time from your instructor dashboard.

pricing_page.faq1_q: How does the free preview mode work?
pricing_page.faq1_a: Every course includes sample lessons designated as free by the mentor. You can enroll and start learning immediately without entering a credit card.
pricing_page.faq2_q: Are there any hidden fees or registration charges?
pricing_page.faq2_a: No. For students, you only pay the displayed course price. For instructors, choose between our free commission-based plan or a fixed monthly subscription with 0% commission.
pricing_page.faq3_q: How are payments and invoicing handled?
pricing_page.faq3_a: All payments are securely processed by Stripe. You receive a digital invoice via email immediately following each transaction.
pricing_page.faq4_q: Can I switch my instructor plan anytime?
pricing_page.faq4_a: Yes! You can upgrade from Free to Pro (or vice versa) anytime from your instructor dashboard with zero cancellation fees.
